data.name: Stoneskin
data.description: The warded creature gains resistance to blows, cuts, stabs, and slashes. The subject gains DR 10/adamantine. It ignores the first 10 points of damage each time it takes damage from a weapon, though an adamantine weapon bypasses the reduction. Once the spell has prevented a total of 10 points of damage per caster level [maximum 150 points], it is discharged.|PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
